offering_description.value: Supplies bulk propane to households, farms, businesses and fleet operators for heating, cooking and fuel. It delivers propane from local distribution facilities and supplies prefilled exchange cylinders through retail stores.

primary_products.value: bulk propane; prefilled portable propane cylinders

primary_services.value: scheduled and on-demand propane delivery; propane tank installation and leasing; portable cylinder exchange

customer_segment.value: B2C: households using propane for heating, cooking or grilling; B2B: retail chains, farms, commercial and industrial facilities, and vehicle fleet operators; B2G: public school districts and municipal fleet operators

end_markets.value: residential heating and cooking; outdoor grilling; commercial and industrial operations; agriculture; fleet transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: bulk propane deliveries and prefilled cylinders sold through retail exchange programs; rental or leasing: stationary propane tanks at customer sites; service fees: tank installation and related on-site work
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys propane from fuel suppliers and delivers it to households, businesses and retail partners; retailer: sells bulk propane directly to residential and commercial end users; asset operator: runs propane storage, cylinder filling and delivery operations for bulk customers and retail partners

geography_served.value: US national: United States through local bulk delivery routes and a nationwide cylinder exchange network

specialization.value: related lines: bulk propane delivery, propane tank services and portable cylinder exchange

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local sales teams and company delivery routes for bulk customers; third-party retail: grocery, hardware, home improvement and convenience stores with cylinder exchange racks; online: customer portal for placing bulk propane orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: propane storage, handling and transport under DOT hazardous materials rules, OSHA standards and state fire codes
